description: Saves a candidate search for the verified user. Every Monday Hire Overseas runs it again and, when there are new candidates, emails the user up to 5 of them (with a one-click unsubscribe). Takes the same search arguments as search_candidates plus a title. At most 5 saved searches per email. Requires lead_token.

brief.description: Structured requirements, e.g. from scope_role or the user's answers to clarifyingQuestions: {mustHaveSkills, niceToHaveSkills, minYearsExperience, regions, budgetMonthlyUsd, hoursPerWeek, timezone, industry}.

description.description: What the person will do, tools they need, hours. More detail gives better matches.

job_description.description: The full job description as text, if the user has one (up to 20,000 characters).

job_description_url.description: An https link to the job description (a job post, PDF or Word file). Hire Overseas fetches and reads it.

lead_token.description: The leadToken from verify_email. Required: shortlists and saved searches belong to the user's verified work email.

minYearsExperience.description: Only return candidates with at least this many years of relevant experience, e.g. 3

regions.description: Limit to regions: ph (Philippines), latam (Latin America), africa. Omit for all.

title.description: A name for the alert, e.g. 'Senior bookkeepers, Xero'

name: save_search
title: Get new candidates for a search by email every week
